summary: Homepage positions an AI notepad without a meeting bot, with private-by-default notes, optional sharing and device-audio capture.
Pricing page offers a free Basic entry and paid Business/Enterprise choices. History, integrations and administration distinguish tiers; public testimonials also appear.
Initial launch post identifies Chris Pedregal as cofounder and CEO and describes AI enhancing a person’s own meeting notes.
Series A post gives the company’s account of adoption by leaders and spread within teams. Its growth and retention claims are company-reported, not independently verified.
Team launch describes shared folders, note links and the ability to query meeting context together.
Later Spaces/API announcement describes controlled team context, personal and enterprise APIs, updated MCP support and organization controls.
Public guide explains analyzing recurring customer-call themes and using folder-level queries for professional workflows.
Robots text advertises the public sitemap.
Public XML sitemap lists product and content pages.
Public llms text resource describes product information and related public resources.

Brief assumptions: hypothetical prelaunch founder in the competitor category, no audience or marketing budget, no live product URL. No paid keys, logins, contact or ad-library audit. No systematic founder/social/Reddit/launch check or numeric search-volume measurement. Strength scores are analyst evidence ratings, not traffic estimates. Proposed playbook counts are experiments, not observed competitor performance. Full homepage archive unavailable.
